run_update_hardware_config: run the example script to update robot hardware config via the orchestrator SDK
create_ROBOT_HARDWARE_COMPONENT: create a ROBOT_HARDWARE_COMPONENT with component name, serial number, model, and firmware number
connect_OrchestratorHelper: connect an OrchestratorHelper instance to the orchestrator service using a robot ID
update_robot_hardware_config: update the robot hardware config in ORCA with a list of hardware components
disconnect_OrchestratorHelper: disconnect an OrchestratorHelper instance from the orchestrator service after completing operations
